title: Yeon Sang-ho Returns to Parasyte Universe With 'Tamiya' on Netflix
excerpt: Yeon Sang-ho returns to the Parasyte universe with a new live-action series 'Parasyte: Tamiya', starring Shioli Kutsuna and set for Netflix release in 2027. Co-written by Yeon and Ryu Yong-jae, the series continues Netflix's expansion of Korean originals and manga adaptations, showcasing cutting-edge VFX and global streaming technology.
description: Yeon Sang-ho returns to the Parasyte universe with 'Parasyte: Tamiya', a new live-action series on Netflix starring Shioli Kutsuna, co-written with Ryu Yong-jae.
